title: Invoicing again bills the new payer with its own term and PO rule
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Net 30 credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the new payer, on the Net 15 credit term, with PO is required on.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today (no payment, deposit or credit applied), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the invoice.
  4. Expand the Customer card.
  5. Click the Bill To field.
  6. Pick customer C in the list.
  7. Open the Finance tab.
  8. Type a purchase order number in Customer PO.
  9. Click Create Invoice.
  10. Open the new invoice's document.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice.

Step 3:

  • Work order 1 is back to Complete.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 5:

  • The list opens.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer C's name.

Step 7:

  • The Finance tab shows Customer PO and Create Invoice.

Step 8:

  • Customer PO shows the number.

Step 9:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 10:

  • The Bill To block names customer C.
  • The term is Net 15 and the due date is today plus 15 days.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12313 (Story 11, Reverse and invoice again)

  • S11-R3: “Invoicing again bills the current Bill To with its current terms and PO rules.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Invoice again after Reverse | Bill To unlocked; new invoice to the current Bill To, same invoice number | n/a | n/a”
  • Key Decisions: “Invoiced means locked; Reverse and invoice again is the only correction, and Reverse works as today. The invoice is removed, AccountingHub keeps the reversal record, QuickBooks deletes its copy and receives the re-issued invoice, which keeps the same number.”
